versions.changelog: Add explicit security/trust notes for local Java/Graphviz rendering and URL-based PlantUML includes; clarify no credentials or account access are required.
Upgrade PlantUML workflow docs: add themes, MEDIA delivery guidance, smoke tests, expanded syntax references, stdlib guide, shared style include, and renderable examples.
Fix absolute path to use portable tilde path
Initial release: supports use case, class, sequence, activity, state, component, deployment, object, timing, and ER diagrams. Includes syntax guide and troubleshooting table.
